hunks.baseline: Ten Monster Waves in a single day were more than enough to plunge the entire world into shock and terror.
hunks.sol: Ten Monster Waves in a single day were enough to plunge the world into shock and terror.

hunks.baseline: What made it worse was that the attacks had occurred in capitals or major cities whose names were known around the world.
Several major Guilds, led by Odin Guild, had swiftly suppressed the Monster Waves, but the resulting damage was immense.
hunks.sol: Worse, they had struck capitals and major cities whose names were known around the world. Several major Guilds, led by Odin Guild, had swiftly suppressed the Monster Waves, but the damage was immense. The confirmed death toll alone had reached several thousand.

hunks.baseline: It was a horrific catastrophe. The confirmed death toll alone had already reached several thousand.
People kept their senses on high alert in their homes or emergency shelters, and Michael Silbert did not miss the opportunity to seize the attention of the entire world.
hunks.sol: People waited in their homes and emergency shelters, alert to every sound. Michael Silbert did not let the moment pass while the whole world was watching.

hunks.baseline: “This is footage Odin Guild obtained when the first Monster Wave occurred in Paris.”
hunks.sol: “This is footage Odin Guild obtained during the first Monster Wave in Paris.”

hunks.baseline: And when people finally saw the CCTV footage that had been released, they were once again thrown into shock.
hunks.sol: When the CCTV footage was released, it sent another shock through the world.

hunks.baseline: > **Odin Guild Master Michael Silbert: “Before this was a Monster Wave, it was a meticulously planned terrorist attack.”**
hunks.sol: > **Odin Guild Master Michael Silbert: “Before it became a Monster Wave, this was a meticulously planned terrorist attack.”**

hunks.baseline: > **Ten killers armed with bombs and Magic Gems. Who are the suicide terrorists shown in the released CCTV footage?**
hunks.sol: > **Ten killers armed with bombs and Magic Gems. Who are the suicide terrorists in the released CCTV footage?**

hunks.baseline: > **Following expert analysis of the CCTV footage: “Each of them possessed several unrefined A-rank Magic Gems, and they carried out the attacks by targeting areas near Gates with high mana concentrations.”**
hunks.sol: > **Experts analyzing the CCTV footage: “Each carried several unrefined A-grade Magic Gems and targeted areas near Gates with high concentrations of magical power.”**

hunks.baseline: > **Bringing in bombs and unrefined A-rank Magic Gems was an obvious violation of international law**
hunks.sol: > **Bringing in bombs and unrefined A-grade Magic Gems: a clear violation of international law**

hunks.baseline: > **The bombs and Magic Gems came from Africa and the Middle East**
hunks.sol: > **Bombs and Magic Gems traced to Africa and the Middle East**

hunks.baseline: Countless news reports poured in from every direction.
hunks.sol: News reports poured in from every direction.

hunks.baseline: Once it became clear that the Monster Waves had not been unstoppable natural disasters but tragedies caused by terrorism, people were consumed by anger and emptiness, and the internet reached saturation point.
hunks.sol: Once people learned that the Monster Waves had not been unavoidable natural disasters but tragedies caused by terrorism, anger and helplessness swept over them. The internet was overwhelmed.

hunks.baseline: > Nothing to say. These guys are seriously insane.
hunks.sol: > I’ve got no words. These people are seriously insane.

hunks.baseline: >> Are they really crazy fuckers?
hunks.sol: >> Are they out of their fucking minds?

hunks.baseline: > The truth must be revealed to the whole world. Every last one of them must be hanged.
hunks.sol: > The truth must be brought to light. Every last one of them must be hanged.

hunks.baseline: > I was reading a foreign article, and it kept mentioning South Korea. Is it talking about the Go Jun incident from a little while ago?
hunks.sol: > I saw a foreign article mentioning South Korea. Is that about the Go Jun incident a little while ago?

hunks.baseline: >> Yeah, that’s right. And because of that, the people who hate Korea are foaming at the mouth and shouting that Korea is the root of all evil.
hunks.sol: >> Yeah. And now the people who hate Korea are foaming at the mouth, saying Korea’s the root of all evil.

hunks.baseline: >> What the fuck? This is ridiculous. They wouldn’t even be alive if it weren’t for Cheon Taemin in the first place.
hunks.sol: >> What the fuck? They wouldn’t even be alive if it weren’t for Cheon Taemin.

hunks.baseline: >> But which country’s people are going around saying such bullshit?
hunks.sol: >> What countries are these people from?

hunks.baseline: >> I can understand Japan, since they’ve always been like that, but why are those Chinese bastards doing it? Have they already forgotten that Lord Fuck helped them?
hunks.sol: >> Japan’s always been like that, but what’s with those Chinese bastards? Have they already forgotten Lord Fuck helped them?

hunks.baseline: >> That one word says everything.
hunks.sol: >> That one word says it all.

hunks.baseline: >> Still, maybe because China received help from him before, it’s definitely much less extreme than Japan. There are even people tracking the IQs of those who curse Lord Fuck in the comments and teaching them a lesson.
hunks.sol: >> To be fair, maybe because he helped them before, it’s nowhere near as bad in China as it is in Japan. Some people are even tracing the IQs of commenters insulting Lord Fuck so they can teach them a lesson.

hunks.baseline: >> I’m IQ 110. Can you track my location with that?
hunks.sol: >> My IQ’s 110. Can they track my location from that?

hunks.baseline: >> I don’t know about anything else, but I have seen people bashing Korea on foreign forums too. Cheon Taemin and Jin Taekyung worked hard to raise Korea’s standing, but that dead bastard Go Jun ruined it all.
hunks.sol: >> I’ve seen people bashing Korea on foreign forums too. Cheon Taemin and Jin Taekyung worked hard to raise Korea’s standing, and that bastard Go Jun[^2] went and ruined it all.

hunks.baseline: >> Jin Taekyung raised Korea’s standing? Are you sure? You wouldn’t know it from the fact that he hasn’t shown his face at all today, lololololol.
hunks.sol: >> Jin Taekyung raised Korea’s standing? You sure? Funny, I haven’t seen him once today wwwwwww.

hunks.baseline: >> Your Air Self-Defense Force hasn’t shown its face since getting beaten up by a Wyvern, either. Though I did get a good look at Tokyo Tower collapsing.
hunks.sol: >> Haven’t seen your Air Self-Defense Force since a Wyvern beat the shit out of it, either. I did get a good look at Tokyo Tower collapsing, though.

hunks.baseline: >> Does Lord Fuck have ten bodies, you Japanese bastard? Watch some TV. Taekyung ran himself ragged today. He was a step late, but seeing him try to save even one person somehow really moved me.
hunks.sol: >> Does Lord Fuck have ten bodies, you Japanese bastard? Turn on the TV. Taekyung ran himself ragged today. He was too late, but watching him try to save even one person got me right in the heart.

hunks.baseline: >> So criticizing Korea automatically makes someone Japanese now, lol? Unfortunately, I’m Korean.
hunks.sol: >> So anyone who criticizes Korea must be Japanese? Too bad, I’m Korean.

hunks.baseline: >> Take the W key off your keyboard if you want to keep pretending to be Korean;;
hunks.sol: >> If you want to keep pretending you’re Korean, take the W key off your keyboard.

hunks.baseline: [^1]: Food-based shorthand used here as derogatory references to Chinese and Japanese people.

hunks.baseline: There was no point paying attention to trolls. The most important thing now was finding out who the terrorists belonged to and why they had committed such acts.
hunks.sol: > Giving a troll attention is a waste of time. What matters now is finding out who these terrorists belong to and why they did this.

hunks.baseline: > The terrorists are all from the Arab world, so it’s obvious. It has to be either Al Qaeda or IS.
hunks.sol: >> They’re all Arabs. It’s obvious. Al Qaeda or IS.

hunks.baseline: >> If it’s so obvious, why are the affected countries still delaying a joint statement or official announcement? This absolutely needs to be verified. Al Qaeda and IS have both suffered serious losses recently.
hunks.sol: >> If it’s so obvious, why haven’t the countries that were hit issued a joint statement or an official announcement? They need to verify it first. Al Qaeda and IS have both taken serious losses lately.

hunks.baseline: >> I agree with the comment above. A few weeks ago, their main bases were completely wrecked and their leader was killed and replaced.
hunks.sol: >> Agreed. Their main bases got wrecked a few weeks ago, and their leaders were killed and replaced.

hunks.baseline: No one was unaware of the bloodbath that had swept through the Middle East and Africa.
hunks.sol: Everyone knew about the bloodbath that had swept through the Middle East and Africa.

hunks.baseline: A mysterious group of vigilantes whose faces, names, and even genders were unknown.

They had beheaded the leaders of the terrorist and rebel groups, and the two factions, suddenly deprived of their leadership, suffered enormous losses in the fierce internal struggles that followed and were forced to raise the white flag.
hunks.sol: A mysterious group of vigilantes had appeared. No one knew their faces, their names, or even their genders. They had beheaded the leaders of the terrorist and rebel groups. With their leadership gone in an instant, the two factions had torn themselves apart in fierce internal struggles, suffered enormous losses, and finally raised the white flag.

hunks.baseline: > Doesn’t that make it even more obvious? They may have been weakened, but if they lost their leader, they could easily have carried out terrorist attacks around the world in the name of revenge.
hunks.sol: > Doesn’t that make it more obvious? They’ve been weakened, sure, but they lost their leaders. Revenge is plenty of reason to attack the whole world.

hunks.baseline: >> There are probably a lot of elementary school kids here who don’t know this, but when the United States got seriously pissed off during the 9/11 attacks, Hussein got scared and denied that it was them. A little while ago, they practically surrendered and begged people to stop, saying they wouldn’t commit any more terrorist attacks. But this terrorist attack involved ten countries, including the United States. Do you really think that makes sense?
hunks.sol: >> Must be a lot of kids here who don’t remember 9/11. When the United States got pissed off, even Hussein got scared and denied his people were behind it. And these groups practically surrendered a little while ago, begging everyone to stop and saying they wouldn’t carry out any more attacks. Now ten countries have been hit, including the United States. You think that makes sense?

hunks.baseline: >> No matter how crazy they are, that’s impossible. Besides, I heard the current leaders of the Middle Eastern terrorist groups belong to the moderate faction.
hunks.sol: >> Not even if they’re crazy. Besides, I heard the new leaders of the Middle Eastern terrorist groups are moderates.

hunks.baseline: >> What the hell is going on?
hunks.sol: >> Then what the hell is going on?

hunks.baseline: This was not a question held only by Korean netizens. News sites and online communities around the world were heated by fierce arguments for and against.
hunks.sol: Korean netizens were hardly the only ones asking. News sites and online communities around the world lit up with arguments.

hunks.baseline: And before long, the answer to that question was broadcast across the world in a single video.
hunks.sol: Before long, the answer was broadcast worldwide in a video.

hunks.baseline: Beneath dim lighting stood an unidentified figure with a robe pulled deeply over their head.
In the grainy footage, the figure called themself the Prophet and pointed to the two heads placed in front of them before continuing.
hunks.sol: Under dim lighting stood an unidentified figure with a robe drawn low over their face. In the grainy footage, the figure called themself the Prophet, pointed to the two heads placed before them, and continued.

hunks.baseline: —I will erase the apostates who abandoned their convictions for the sake of their own safety from this sacred land, and establish rightful vengeance and justice throughout the world.
hunks.sol: —I will wipe from this sacred land the apostates who abandoned their convictions for their own safety. I will bring rightful vengeance and justice to the world.

hunks.baseline: It was not difficult for people to recognize the owners of the heads.
They were the leaders of the most dangerous terrorist organizations in the world, and only a short while ago, they had announced a humiliating surrender.
hunks.sol: It was not hard to recognize whose heads they were. They had led the world’s most dangerous terrorist organizations, and only recently had announced a humiliating surrender.

hunks.baseline: IS.
And Al Qaeda.
hunks.sol: IS. And Al Qaeda.

hunks.baseline: Before the horribly beheaded former leaders, the Prophet slowly parted their lips.
hunks.sol: Standing before the severed heads of their former leaders, the Prophet spoke again.

hunks.baseline: The people watching the video caught their breath without realizing it.
hunks.sol: The people watching held their breath.

hunks.baseline: Judgment.
Today’s horrific tragedy was only the beginning.
hunks.sol: *Judge them? Today’s horror was only the beginning?*

hunks.baseline: Those who widened their eyes as if they could not believe it nevertheless realized instinctively.
The unidentified figure who called themself the Prophet was not making empty threats.

hunks.baseline: Even now, they could detonate a bomb somewhere in the world and bring about another disaster.
hunks.sol: Yet even those staring at the screen in disbelief understood it instinctively. The unidentified figure calling themself the Prophet was not making an empty threat. They could set off a bomb anywhere in the world right now and bring about another disaster.

hunks.baseline: And then.
The Prophet’s final words pierced the ears of the frozen audience.
hunks.sol: Then the Prophet’s final words reached the stunned audience.

hunks.baseline: —Inshallah. Know that all of this began with you.
hunks.sol: —Inshallah. Know that you brought all of this upon yourselves.

hunks.baseline: The short video ended amid a burst of harsh static.
hunks.sol: The short video ended in a burst of harsh static.

hunks.baseline: No—just when everyone thought it had ended, another screen began transmitting.
hunks.sol: Or so everyone thought. Another image began to play.

hunks.baseline: It was a dark night in which even the moonlight was hazy.
A lone figure standing in a desert filled with blood and corpses suddenly raised their head. The face glimpsed through the mask resembled someone everyone knew.
hunks.sol: It was a dark night, with even the moonlight faint. A lone figure stood amid blood and corpses in the desert, then suddenly raised their head. The face glimpsed beneath the mask resembled someone everyone knew.

hunks.baseline: Holding a silver tray in one hand, he kept his gaze fixed on the smartphone in the other.
hunks.sol: He held a silver tray in one hand, his eyes fixed on the smartphone in the other.

hunks.baseline: > **Monster Wave in Madrid, Spain. Terrorism Again?**
hunks.sol: > **Monster Wave in Madrid, Spain. Another Terrorist Attack?**

hunks.baseline: > **The Notorious Terrorist Who Vanished Like a Ghost: “The Prophet”**
hunks.sol: > **The Prophet: Notorious Terrorist Vanishes Like a Ghost**

hunks.baseline: > **Video Analysis Shows a 99.99% Match. Another Identity of a Young Hero**
hunks.sol: > **Video Analysis Finds a 99.99% Match: Young Hero’s Other Identity**

hunks.baseline: > **Joguk Ilbo Chief Editorial Writer Lee Kanghee: “A Tragedy Born of Pointless Heroism”**
hunks.sol: > **Joguk Ilbo Chief Editorial Writer Lee Kanghee: “A Tragedy Born of Misguided Heroism”**

hunks.baseline: > **Public Opinion on a Knife-Edge: A Criminal Intoxicated by Heroism, or a Vigilante of Darkness?**
hunks.sol: > **Public Opinion Divided: A Criminal Drunk on Heroism, or a Vigilante in the Shadows?**

hunks.baseline: “……Damn humans.”
hunks.sol: “…Damn humans.”

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King muttered a curse without realizing it.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King muttered the curse before he knew it.

hunks.baseline: Even from the brief glance he had taken, the state of the online news pages was a complete mess.
The front page was filled with nothing but openly condemnatory articles and sensational headlines, while fierce battles between netizens raged beneath them.
hunks.sol: Even a brief look told him the online news pages were a mess. The front page was full of sensational headlines and articles openly condemning Jin Taekyung. Beneath them, netizens were fighting it out.

hunks.baseline: > Lol, look at the level of these garbage reporters’ headlines.
hunks.sol: > Lol, look at these garbage reporters’ headlines.

hunks.baseline: >> For real. They’re desperate to increase their views. The articles say nothing and are all stitched together from scraps.
hunks.sol: >> Seriously. They’re desperate for clicks. Nothing in the articles, either—just bits and pieces stitched together.

hunks.baseline: >> But if you only look at the headline, it isn’t entirely wrong, is it?
hunks.sol: >> But going by the headlines, they’re not entirely wrong, are they?

hunks.baseline: >> Honestly, I like Lord Fuck too, but I think he really did act rashly this time.
hunks.sol: >> Honestly, I like Lord Fuck too, but I think he acted too hastily this time.

hunks.baseline: > This deserves criticism. There’s nothing he can say for himself.
hunks.sol: > He deserves the criticism. What can he even say in his defense?

hunks.baseline: >> What do you mean, there’s nothing he can say? A few weeks ago, when he completely wrecked Al Qaeda and the others, you were all cheering. Whoever he was, you said it felt great to see him wipe those bastards out.
hunks.sol: >> What do you mean? A few weeks ago, when he wrecked Al Qaeda and the others, you were all cheering. You didn’t know who did it, but you said it felt great to see those bastards wiped out.

hunks.baseline: >> That doesn’t mean what he did was right.
hunks.sol: >> That doesn’t mean it was right.

hunks.baseline: >> So it was fine then but not now? You’re fucking crazy, lol.
hunks.sol: >> It was fine then but not now? You’re fucking nuts, lol.

hunks.baseline: >> The situation has changed. Seriously, how many people are dead now? Nationalist hype and personal fandom are all well and good, but look at how serious the situation has become because of what Jin Taekyung did.
hunks.sol: >> Things have changed. How many people have died now? National pride and being a fan are all well and good, but look at what Jin Taekyung’s actions have led to.

hunks.baseline: > I knew that bastard Jin Taekyung would cause trouble. I hated watching him get full of himself from the moment people started hyping him up as a young hero and the next Cheon Taemin.
hunks.sol: > I knew that bastard Jin Taekyung would cause trouble. I couldn’t stand watching him get full of himself when everyone started calling him a young hero and the next Cheon Taemin.

hunks.baseline: >> That’s complete bullshit. When was he ever full of himself? Even when the media was hyping him nonstop, hyung still walked around in a tracksuit.
hunks.sol: >> What a load of shit. When was he ever full of himself? Even when the media was hyping him up, hyung was still walking around in a tracksuit.

hunks.baseline: > Putting it neutrally, I personally just think it’s unfortunate. Do you really think Jin Taekyung did that because he was some bloodthirsty killer?
hunks.sol: > I’m trying to stay neutral here, but honestly, it’s just sad. Do you really think Jin Taekyung did it because he’s some bloodthirsty killer?

hunks.baseline: >> Look at the timing. It was right before the Mana Cultivation Method was released. Seriously, do you think there are only one or two Awakened among the Middle Eastern terrorists and African rebel groups? Who was supposed to deal with them if they learned the Mana Cultivation Method and started committing every kind of crime, including terrorism?
hunks.sol: >> Look at the timing. It was right before the Mana Cultivation Method was released. There are plenty of Awakened among the Middle Eastern terrorists and African rebels. If they learned it and started using it for terrorism and every other kind of crime, who would deal with them?

hunks.baseline: >> Fine, you’re right. But let’s be precise. Everyone justified it back then. Now that one unbelievably insane bastard has appeared, you’re all switching sides at the speed of light.
hunks.sol: >> You’re right. But let’s be clear: everyone justified it back then. Now one unbelievably insane bastard has shown up, and everyone’s changed their tune at the speed of light.

hunks.baseline: >> At the time, people both at home and abroad were universally praising the vigilantes. “Whoever you are, great job. Let’s not bother finding out who they are.” That was the atmosphere, and now it has completely reversed.
hunks.sol: >> People at home and abroad were all praising the vigilantes at the time. “Whoever they are, great job. Let’s not ask too many questions.” That was the mood. Now it’s flipped.

hunks.baseline: > There are a lot of Jin Taekyung fanboys here, lol. That doesn’t change the fact that he’s being condemned around the world.
hunks.sol: > Lot of Jin Taekyung fanboys here, lol. He’s still being condemned worldwide.

hunks.baseline: >> The fact is, polls show that more people support Lord Fuck. It only looks otherwise because sensational headlines are being mass-produced.
hunks.sol: >> Polls show more people support Lord Fuck. It only looks otherwise because the news sites keep churning out sensational headlines.

hunks.baseline: > What I don’t understand is Cheon Taemin. Even now, he hasn’t shown his face once. Jin Taekyung has been missing for several days too.
hunks.sol: > What I don’t get is Cheon Taemin. Even now, he hasn’t shown his face once. Jin Taekyung’s been missing for days too.

hunks.baseline: >> He caused trouble and is pretending it has nothing to do with him. Seriously disgusting, lol. Just look at Odin Guild. King-God Michael is the past and the future.
hunks.sol: >> Caused a disaster and now he’s acting like it’s none of his business. Disgusting, lol. Look at Odin Guild instead. King-God Michael is the past and the future.

hunks.baseline: As he read through the comments beneath the online articles, the Skeleton King suddenly wondered:
hunks.sol: Reading the comments, the Skeleton King found himself wondering:

hunks.baseline: *If they learned the truth, what kind of expressions would the humans who posted those comments make?*
But the Skeleton King knew that it was all a pointless thought.
hunks.sol: *What faces would those humans make if they knew the truth?*

hunks.baseline: At least for now, there was no way to reveal the truth. On the contrary, they might be completely sunk by the backlash.
hunks.sol: But he knew the thought was pointless. At least for now, they could reveal none of it. The backlash might sink them completely.

hunks.baseline: The society of humans he had experienced so far was far more complicated and frustrating than he had expected.
hunks.sol: Human society, as he had come to know it, was far more complicated—and far more frustrating—than he had expected.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King shook his head and stopped in front of a massive door.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King shook his head and stopped before a massive door.

hunks.baseline: When he discovered that the silver tray he had brought yesterday was still sitting there, he let out a deep sigh and carefully pulled on the doorknob.
hunks.sol: The silver tray he had left there yesterday was still untouched. He sighed deeply, then carefully pulled the doorknob.

hunks.baseline: Beyond the slowly opening door, he saw the back of someone sitting cross-legged.
hunks.sol: As the door slowly opened, he saw someone sitting cross-legged with their back to him.

[^1]: *Jjajang* and *wasabi* are food-based shorthand used here to refer disparagingly to Chinese and Japanese people.
[^2]: The Korean comment alters Go Jun’s name with a character meaning “the late,” mocking him as though he were already dead.
